question: Should multi-operator dashboard presence become a bundled dashboard capability after the Wave 1 workspace stack, and what operator identity/privacy boundary should it use?
rationale: This is a new multi-user product surface layered on unmerged dashboard work, and code inspection cannot decide whether bundled OpenClaw should expose live per-tab viewer/editor state.

options.title: Sequence After Wave 1
options.body: Keep this issue open and revisit implementation once the dashboard store, Workspaces UI, and event substrate are accepted or narrowed.

options.title: Fold Into Dashboard Review
options.body: Require the Wave 1 dashboard PRs to include a presence-compatible event contract before the first dashboard release lands.

options.title: Move Out Of Core
options.body: If bundled dashboard work is not accepted, ask for this to live as an external plugin or ClawHub package using whatever public seams remain.

recommendation.title: Sequence After Wave 1
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and revisit implementation once the dashboard store, Workspaces UI, and event substrate are accepted or narrowed.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main owner signal for the Control UI plugin-tab and Gateway presence/broadcast surfaces involved in this choice.
